source.publication: 2025 Form 760 Resident Individual Income Tax Instructions (with the 2025 Form 760)
source.section: Form 760 Lines 1-3, 7-9, 11, 12, 14-16; Schedule ADJ Lines 6-7, code 60 Military Benefits Subtraction (PDF p28, printed Page 22); PDF p15 Exemptions; PDF p17 Line 11; PDF p41 Tax Rate Schedule; Spouse Tax Adjustment Worksheet (PDF p18, printed Page 12), not applied by the projection

worked: Federal (given, not tested): Federal AGI = wages (spouse) 40,000.00 + military retired pay (you) 50,000.00 + military retired pay (spouse) 30,000.00 = 120,000.00. Federal taxable income = 120,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 88,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 760 Line 1 federal AGI 120,000.00. Line 2 additions 0.00 (no other-state municipal interest). Line 3 = 120,000.00. Line 4 age deduction = 0.00. Line 5 taxable Social Security subtracted = 0.00. Line 6 state refund 0.00. Schedule ADJ Line 6 code 60 military benefits subtraction, each person's own maximum: you: smaller of 50,000.00 and 40,000.00 = 40,000.00; spouse: smaller of 30,000.00 and 40,000.00 = 30,000.00; Schedule ADJ Line 7 total = 70,000.00; Form 760 Line 7 = 70,000.00. Line 8 = 0.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 + 70,000.00 = 70,000.00. Line 9 VAGI = 120,000.00 - 70,000.00 = 50,000.00. Line 11 standard deduction (Filing Status 2) = 17,500.00. Line 12 exemptions: Section A 2 x 930.00 = 1,860.00; Section B 0 x 800.00 (65 or older) = 0.00; total 1,860.00. Line 14 = 19,360.00. Line 15 Virginia taxable income = 50,000.00 - 19,360.00 = 30,640.00. Line 16 tax, rate schedule (PDF p41) as numbers: 720.00 + 5.75% x (30,640.00 - 17,000.00 = 13,640.00) = 720.00 + 784.30 = 1,504.30 (the form rounds to the whole dollar: 1,504.00). Line 17 Spouse Tax Adjustment 0.00 under the projection (see the note below). Credits none modelled or claimed, 0.00. Virginia income tax = 1,504.30. Each spouse has his or her own 40,000 maximum: you are over it, the spouse under it, and the spouse's unused 10,000.00 does not carry to you. No age deduction (both born after January 1, 1961). Spouse Tax Adjustment on the form: separate VAGI less exemptions you 50,000.00 - 40,000.00 - 930.00 = 9,070.00, spouse 70,000.00 - 30,000.00 - 930.00 = 39,070.00; line 4 30,640.00; line 5 9,070.00; line 6 21,570.00; line 7 15,320.00; line 8 tax on 9,070.00 = 323.50; line 9 tax on 21,570.00 = 982.775; line 10 1,306.275; line 12 = 1,504.30 - 1,306.275 = 198.025 (about 198); not applied (approximation).
accepted_approximations: The Spouse Tax Adjustment (Form 760 Line 17), a reduction of up to 259 for a joint return where both spouses have income, is not applied.
